item.title: Police Warn of Hazardous Travel as Heavy Rain Moves into Highlands and Islands
item.description: Police Scotland has warned of hazardous travel across the Highlands and Islands as heavy rain moves in, with flooding and transport disruption expected under ongoing weather warnings.The post Police Warn of Hazardous Travel as Heavy Rain Moves into Highlands and Islands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Orkney Council Leader Urges Rethink on UK Funding for Islands
item.description: Orkney Islands Council leader Heather Woodbridge has urged the UK Government to rethink its Local Growth Fund after Orkney and the wider Highlands and Islands received no funding, warning the current system ignores the real costs of island life and risks undermining vital communities.The post Orkney Council Leader Urges Rethink on UK Funding for Islands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Frozen Cars and Empty Wallets as Winter Faults Risk Wiping Out Two Months Rent
item.description: UK drivers are being warned that common winter car faults could lead to repair bills of up to £2,481, with new data from Carly showing cold weather breakdowns risk wiping out months of household budgets during peak winter travel periods.The post Frozen Cars and Empty Wallets as Winter Faults Risk Wiping Out Two Months Rent appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highlands MSP Makes Case for Community Led Housing at Holyrood
item.description: A Highlands and Islands MSP has told a Holyrood committee that community led housing is vital for rural Scotland, securing confirmation from ministers that support will continue to help small villages retain key workers and remain sustainable.The post Highlands MSP Makes Case for Community Led Housing at Holyrood appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Funding Green Light Allows Orkney Ferry Replacement Programme to Move Forward
item.description: Long awaited funding confirmation means Orkney Islands Council can now move forward with replacing ageing inter island ferries, a critical step for island communities that depend on reliable connections for work, healthcare and daily life.The post Funding Green Light Allows Orkney Ferry Replacement Programme to Move Forward appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Free Online Support Offers Lifeline to Argyll and Bute Businesses
item.description: Free online Business Gateway webinars are helping Argyll and Bute businesses build skills, grow confidently and adapt to modern challenges, with hundreds of local firms already benefiting from expert led support delivered directly to their screens.The post Free Online Support Offers Lifeline to Argyll and Bute Businesses appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Character Cottage at The Heart of Grantown on Spey
item.description: Set on the High Street in Grantown on Spey, this character cottage offers flexible accommodation, a central location, and the opportunity to shape a home over time within the Cairngorms National Park.The post A Character Cottage at The Heart of Grantown on Spey appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Grangemouth Closure Leaves UK Exposed to Russian Oil Imports
item.description: Industry leaders warn the closure of Grangemouth has left the UK exposed to Russian oil imports, as energy groups and SNP politicians criticise UK Government policy for weakening energy security and accelerating job losses across Scotland’s energy sector.The post Grangemouth Closure Leaves UK Exposed to Russian Oil Imports appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Path Order Clears Way For Final Section of Peffery Way
item.description: A key legal step has cleared the way for completion of the Peffery Way, a community led walking and cycling route linking Dingwall and Strathpeffer, after Highland Council secured a rare Public Path Order to unlock the final section.The post Path Order Clears Way For Final Section of Peffery Way appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Elgin Academy Pupils Share Burns Night Message of Hope With Ukrainian School
item.description: Elgin Academy pupils have shared a Burns Night message of friendship with a partner school in Ukraine, using poetry and music to show solidarity and support for young people learning under the strain of ongoing conflict.The post Elgin Academy Pupils Share Burns Night Message of Hope With Ukrainian School appeared first on The Highland Times.
